tasks.title: Low-waste school event
tasks.instruction: Your English teacher has asked you to write an essay on how to organise a low-waste school event. Write an essay discussing two of the points in the notes below. You should explain which point is more important and give reasons for your opinion. You may add an idea of your own.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write an essay on how to organise a low-waste school event.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes
listItems: encourage people to bring their own containers

tasks.title: Low-waste school event participation
tasks.instruction: You see this announcement on a college noticeboard. Write your review.

promptBlocks.heading: College Magazine
paragraphs: Have you taken part in a low-waste event? Write a review of the event you attended. Describe what happened, say what you liked or disliked about it, and recommend whether other students should participate in similar events in the future.
The best reviews will be published in the next issue of the college magazine.

tasks.title: Low-waste school event long-term value
tasks.instruction: You see this announcement in an international student magazine. Write your article.

promptBlocks.heading: International Student Magazine
paragraphs: Articles wanted: The long-term value of low-waste events

What lasting benefits can low-waste school events bring to students and the school community? Write an article describing at least two positive effects and explaining why organising such events is worthwhile in the long term.
The best articles will be published on our website.

tasks.title: Low-waste school event advice
tasks.instruction: You have received an email from your English-speaking friend, Sam. Write your email.

promptBlocks.subject: Low-waste event at my school
paragraphs: My school is planning a low-waste event and I'm on the organising committee. I want to make sure it has a lasting impact on students' habits. What advice can you give me to make the event effective in the long term? Also, how can we encourage students to keep practising low-waste habits after the event?
Thanks for your help! Hope to hear from you soon.
